name: client-python-coherent-portable-collection-dc91
instr:
Add coherent, portable metric snapshots that preserve collector boundaries, revision identity, completeness, and every recorded metric field. A captured attempt must be immutable, deterministic to serialize, and replayable without consulting its original collectors or storage. Existing live collection and Graphite behavior must remain unchanged.

`CollectorRegistry.snapshot` fixes membership at attempt start, preserves registration order, and retries only collectors whose revisions prove unstable, leaving stable results untouched. Every native collector snapshot is a detached, coherent observation: labelled wrappers bind children and values, GC binds all generations, process metrics bind one process identity while retaining available sections, platform metadata remains construction-time data, and multiprocess aggregation binds one mmap file set while tolerating disappearing live gauges. Local and mmap-backed revisions change with every snapshot-visible value, timestamp, exemplar, or native-histogram change. `dumps_snapshot(snapshot)` and `loads_snapshot(data)` round-trip all supported fields deterministically; invalid, unsupported, or inconsistent documents raise `SnapshotFormatError` with no partial result. `FrozenCollector.collect(self)` and the existing `collect(self)` contract expose recorded families repeatedly without live access, while incomplete replay requires explicit permission. `GraphiteBridge.push_snapshot(self, snapshot, prefix='')` validates before connecting,
